//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb"
	smbwindows "github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/windows"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/transport/httprest"
	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const coldIOBytes = 64 << 10

// The layouts are Win32 structures, not SMB QUERY_INFO payloads.
// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winbase/ns-winbase-file_basic_info
// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winbase/ns-winbase-file_standard_info
// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winbase/ns-winbase-file_id_info
type nativeBasicInformation struct {
	CreationTime, LastAccessTime, LastWriteTime, ChangeTime int64
	FileAttributes                                          uint32
	padding                                                 uint32
}

type nativeStandardInformation struct {
	AllocationSize, EndOfFile int64
	NumberOfLinks             uint32
	DeletePending, Directory  uint8
	padding                   [2]byte
}

type nativeFileIdentity struct {
	VolumeSerialNumber uint64
	FileID             [16]byte
}

func (n nativeFileIdentity) fields() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{"native_volume_serial_hex": fmt.Sprintf("%016x", n.VolumeSerialNumber), "native_file_id_hex": hex.EncodeToString(n.FileID[:])}
}

func sameNativeIdentity(first, second nativeFileIdentity) error {
	if first != second {
		return errors.New("native identity tuple changed on the same HANDLE")
	}
	return nil
}

type coldNativeCalls struct {
	open     func(string) (windows.Handle, error)
	basic    func(windows.Handle) (nativeBasicInformation, error)
	standard func(windows.Handle) (nativeStandardInformation, error)
	identity func(windows.Handle) (nativeFileIdentity, error)
	read     func(windows.Handle, []byte) (uint32, error)
	close    func(windows.Handle) error
}

func currentNativeCalls() coldNativeCalls {
	return coldNativeCalls{
		open: func(path string) (windows.Handle, error) {
			name, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
			if err != nil {
				return windows.InvalidHandle, err
			}
			handle, err := windows.CreateFile(name, windows.GENERIC_READ,
				windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil,
				windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, 0)
			runtime.KeepAlive(name)
			return handle, err
		},
		basic: func(handle windows.Handle) (nativeBasicInformation, error) {
			var value nativeBasicInformation
			err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(handle, windows.FileBasicInfo, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&value)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(value)))
			runtime.KeepAlive(&value)
			return value, err
		},
		standard: func(handle windows.Handle) (nativeStandardInformation, error) {
			var value nativeStandardInformation
			err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(handle, windows.FileStandardInfo, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&value)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(value)))
			runtime.KeepAlive(&value)
			return value, err
		},
		identity: func(handle windows.Handle) (nativeFileIdentity, error) {
			var value nativeFileIdentity
			err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(handle, windows.FileIdInfo, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&value)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(value)))
			runtime.KeepAlive(&value)
			return value, err
		},
		read: func(handle windows.Handle, data []byte) (uint32, error) {
			var done uint32
			err := windows.ReadFile(handle, data, &done, nil)
			runtime.KeepAlive(data)
			return done, err
		},
		close: windows.CloseHandle,
	}
}

func coldLimits() smb.Limits {
	limits := smb.DefaultLimits()
	limits.MaxExports, limits.MaxConnections, limits.MaxSessions, limits.MaxTrees = 1, 4, 4, 4
	limits.MaxOpens, limits.MaxRequests, limits.MaxCompound, limits.MaxContexts = 16, 16, 8, 8
	limits.MaxIOBytes, limits.MaxFrameBytes = coldIOBytes, 2*coldIOBytes
	// Captured metadata shares a per-tree pool across CREATE, READ and QUERY_INFO.
	// Its reservation is independent of the smaller SMB wire I/O bound.
	limits.MaxDirectoryBytes = 8 << 20
	limits.MaxNotifyEvents, limits.MaxNotifyBytes = 8, 64<<10
	limits.HandshakeTimeout, limits.RequestTimeout, limits.CleanupTimeout = 10*time.Second, 10*time.Second, 5*time.Second
	limits.FileSession.MaxFileSize, limits.FileSession.MaxFiles = coldIOBytes, 16
	limits.FileSession.MaxOperations, limits.FileSession.MaxWaiters = 16, 16
	limits.FileSession.MaxLockOwners, limits.FileSession.MaxLockRanges = 16, 16
	limits.FileSession.MaxPendingLocks, limits.FileSession.MaxLockActions = 16, 16
	return limits
}

func coldDialOptions() httprest.DialOptions {
	o := httprest.DefaultDialOptions()
	o.MaxBodyBytes, o.MaxWriteBytes = 1<<20, coldIOBytes
	return o
}

func runSMBPhase(ctx context.Context, o options) (receipt, error) {
	state, err := readState(o)
	if err != nil {
		return receipt{}, err
	}
	switch o.Phase {
	case coldCleanupPhase:
		if err := cleanupSMBMapping(ctx, o); err != nil {
			return receipt{}, err
		}
		return coldReceipt(o, state), nil
	case coldPhase:
		return runColdSMB(ctx, o, state)
	default:
		return receipt{}, errors.New("invalid current SMB phase")
	}
}

func coldReceipt(o options, state probeState) receipt {
	return receipt{RunID: o.RunID, SourceSHA: o.SourceSHA, FixtureNonce: o.FixtureNonce, Phase: o.Phase,
		Sequence: o.Sequence, Status: "ok", AuthorityEpoch: state.AuthorityEpoch, ObjectID: strconv.FormatUint(state.Reference.Attr.ID, 10)}
}

func runColdSMB(ctx context.Context, o options, state probeState) (answer receipt, returned error) {
	if _, err := expectedNativeBasic(state.Reference.Attr); err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	observer, err := newColdObserver(o, state)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	defer func() {
		status := "ok"
		if returned != nil {
			status = "error"
		}
		returned = errors.Join(returned, observer.Record(map[string]any{"kind": "cold-result", "status": status, "error": coldError(returned)}), observer.Close())
	}()
	transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	transport.Proxy = nil
	transport.DialContext = (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 4 * time.Second}).DialContext
	transport.MaxConnsPerHost = 8
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	client, err := httprest.DialWithOptions(o.Endpoint, &http.Client{
		Transport: observer.Transport(transport), Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return errors.New("HTTP redirects are forbidden") },
	}, coldDialOptions())
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	if err := checkColdAuthority(ctx, client, state); err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	sid, err := smbwindows.CurrentUserSID()
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	authorize, err := smbwindows.AllowSID(sid)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	server, err := smb.New(smb.Config{Authenticator: smbwindows.NewAuthenticator(), Authorize: authorize, Limits: coldLimits()})
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	var export *smb.Export
	var listener net.Listener
	var mapping *ownedSMBMapping
	var serveDone chan error
	var serveCancel context.CancelFunc
	var serveJoined bool
	var serveErr error
	complete := false
	defer func() {
		cleanup, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		var cleanupErr error
		if mapping != nil {
			cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, mapping.Cleanup(cleanup))
		}
		cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, server.Shutdown(cleanup))
		if serveCancel != nil {
			serveCancel()
		}
		if listener != nil {
			if err := listener.Close(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed) {
				cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, err)
			}
		}
		if serveDone != nil && !serveJoined {
			select {
			case serveErr = <-serveDone:
				serveJoined = true
			case <-cleanup.Done():
				cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, fmt.Errorf("join SMB Serve: %w", cleanup.Err()))
			}
		}
		cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, serveErr)
		if export != nil {
			cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, export.Unpublish(cleanup))
		}
		status := server.Status()
		cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, checkColdStopped(status))
		cleanupErr = errors.Join(cleanupErr, observer.Record(map[string]any{"kind": "smb-cleanup", "status": coldStatus(cleanupErr), "error": coldError(cleanupErr), "resources": status, "serve_joined": serveDone == nil || serveJoined}))
		transport.CloseIdleConnections()
		returned = errors.Join(returned, cleanupErr)
		if returned == nil && complete {
			returned = observer.Validate()
		}
	}()
	share := "rfs-" + o.FixtureNonce
	export, err = server.Publish(smb.Share{Name: share, Volume: fixtureVolume, Backend: client})
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	listener, err = net.Listen("tcp4", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	port := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
	serveCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	serveCancel = cancel
	serveDone = make(chan error, 1)
	observedListener := observer.Listener(listener)
	go func() { serveDone <- server.Serve(serveCtx, observedListener) }()
	for !server.Status().Serving {
		select {
		case serveErr = <-serveDone:
			serveJoined = true
			return answer, errors.Join(errors.New("SMB Serve ended before publication became available"), serveErr)
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return answer, ctx.Err()
		case <-time.After(time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	if err := observer.Record(map[string]any{"kind": "smb-host", "status": "ok", "sid": sid, "share": share, "volume": fixtureVolume, "port": port, "max_io_bytes": coldIOBytes, "mapping_ledger": "smb-mapping.json"}); err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	mapping, err = newSMBMapping(ctx, o, share, uint16(port))
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	if mapping == nil {
		return answer, errors.New("mapping creation returned no owned mapping")
	}
	path := filepath.Join(mapping.LocalPath()+`\`, state.SentinelName)
	if err := runNativeCold(ctx, state, path, currentNativeCalls(), observer.Record); err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	if err := checkColdAuthority(ctx, client, state); err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	complete = true
	return coldReceipt(o, state), nil
}

func checkColdAuthority(ctx context.Context, client *httprest.Storage, state probeState) error {
	status, err := client.Status(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if status.Authority != state.AuthorityEpoch || status.Unavailable || status.Recovering {
		return errors.New("cold probe reached a different or unavailable authority")
	}
	root, err := client.Stat(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if root.ID != state.RootID || root.Kind != storage.NodeDirectory || root.BirthTime == nil || root.ChangeTime == nil {
		return errors.New("cold root identity or actual timestamps differ")
	}
	attr, err := client.Stat(ctx, state.SentinelName)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := sameAttr(attr, state.Reference.Attr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	current, err := expectedNativeBasic(attr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	expected, err := expectedNativeBasic(state.Reference.Attr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if current != expected {
		return errors.New("cold sentinel timestamps changed after seeding")
	}
	return nil
}

func checkColdStopped(status smb.Status) error {
	if status.Serving || !status.Stopped || status.Exports != 0 || status.StoppingExports != 0 || status.Connections != 0 ||
		status.RetainedConnections != 0 || status.Sessions != 0 || status.Trees != 0 || status.PendingRequests != 0 ||
		status.OpenReservations != 0 || status.InstalledHandles != 0 || status.CleanupPendingHandles != 0 ||
		status.FencedAuthorities != 0 || status.CleanupFailures != 0 {
		return errors.New("SMB cleanup did not confirm an empty stopped host")
	}
	return nil
}

func expectedNativeBasic(attr storage.Attr) (nativeBasicInformation, error) {
	var value nativeBasicInformation
	if attr.Kind != storage.NodeRegular || attr.ID == 0 || attr.Size < 0 || attr.BirthTime == nil || attr.ChangeTime == nil {
		return value, errors.New("cold sentinel requires regular-file identity, EOF and actual creation/change timestamps")
	}
	if _, exists := attr.Metadata["smb.windows"]; exists {
		return value, errors.New("cold sentinel unexpectedly carries Windows-specific metadata")
	}
	fields := []*int64{&value.CreationTime, &value.LastAccessTime, &value.LastWriteTime, &value.ChangeTime}
	for i, instant := range []time.Time{*attr.BirthTime, attr.AccessTime, attr.ModTime, *attr.ChangeTime} {
		ticks, err := coldFiletime(instant)
		if err != nil {
			return value, err
		}
		*fields[i] = ticks
	}
	value.FileAttributes = windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL
	return value, nil
}

func coldFiletime(instant time.Time) (int64, error) {
	const epoch = int64(11644473600)
	const ticks = int64(10000000)
	last := time.Unix(math.MaxInt64/ticks-epoch, (math.MaxInt64%ticks)*100+99)
	if instant.Before(time.Unix(-epoch, 0)) || instant.After(last) {
		return 0, errors.New("cold sentinel time is outside signed FILETIME range")
	}
	return (instant.Unix()+epoch)*ticks + int64(instant.Nanosecond()/100), nil
}

func coldError(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return err.Error()
}
func coldStatus(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return "ok"
	}
	return "error"
}

func observeNativeCall(ctx context.Context, record func(map[string]any) error, api string, call func() (map[string]any, error), accepts func(error) bool) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	started := time.Now()
	fields, apiErr := call()
	completed := time.Now()
	if fields == nil {
		fields = make(map[string]any)
	}
	fields["kind"], fields["api"] = "native", api
	fields["started"], fields["completed"] = started.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), completed.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	fields["elapsed_ns"] = completed.Sub(started).Nanoseconds()
	fields["status"], fields["error"] = coldStatus(apiErr), coldError(apiErr)
	if apiErr != nil {
		var errno syscall.Errno
		if errors.As(apiErr, &errno) {
			fields["error_code"] = uint32(errno)
		}
	}
	accepted := apiErr != nil && accepts != nil && accepts(apiErr)
	if accepted {
		fields["accepted_error"] = true
	}
	recordErr := record(fields)
	if accepted {
		apiErr = nil
	}
	return errors.Join(apiErr, recordErr, ctx.Err())
}

func runNativeCold(ctx context.Context, state probeState, path string, calls coldNativeCalls, record func(map[string]any) error) (returned error) {
	if len(state.Content) == 0 || len(state.Content) > coldIOBytes || int64(len(state.Content)) != state.Reference.Attr.Size || digest(state.Content) != state.ContentSHA256 {
		return errors.New("cold native content expectation is invalid")
	}
	expectedBasic, err := expectedNativeBasic(state.Reference.Attr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	handle := windows.InvalidHandle
	defer func() {
		if handle == windows.InvalidHandle || handle == 0 {
			return
		}
		cleanup, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		returned = errors.Join(returned, observeNativeCall(cleanup, record, "CloseHandle", func() (map[string]any, error) {
			return nil, calls.close(handle)
		}, nil))
	}()
	if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "CreateFileW", func() (map[string]any, error) {
		var err error
		handle, err = calls.open(path)
		return map[string]any{"access": uint32(windows.GENERIC_READ), "share": uint32(windows.FILE_SHARE_READ | windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE | windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE), "disposition": uint32(windows.OPEN_EXISTING), "flags": uint32(windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL), "handle_valid": handle != 0 && handle != windows.InvalidHandle}, err
	}, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if handle == 0 || handle == windows.InvalidHandle {
		return errors.New("CreateFileW returned no valid HANDLE")
	}
	var basic nativeBasicInformation
	if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileBasicInfo)", func() (map[string]any, error) {
		var err error
		basic, err = calls.basic(handle)
		return map[string]any{"native_basic": basic}, err
	}, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if basic.CreationTime != expectedBasic.CreationTime || basic.LastAccessTime != expectedBasic.LastAccessTime ||
		basic.LastWriteTime != expectedBasic.LastWriteTime || basic.ChangeTime != expectedBasic.ChangeTime || basic.FileAttributes != expectedBasic.FileAttributes {
		return errors.New("native Basic information differs from the captured sentinel")
	}
	var standard nativeStandardInformation
	if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileStandardInfo)", func() (map[string]any, error) {
		var err error
		standard, err = calls.standard(handle)
		return map[string]any{"native_standard": standard}, err
	}, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if standard.EndOfFile != state.Reference.Attr.Size || standard.AllocationSize != (state.Reference.Attr.Size+511)/512*512 ||
		standard.NumberOfLinks != 1 || standard.DeletePending != 0 || standard.Directory != 0 {
		return errors.New("native Standard information differs from the linked sentinel's dense virtual allocation and EOF")
	}
	var first nativeFileIdentity
	if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileIdInfo)", func() (map[string]any, error) {
		var err error
		first, err = calls.identity(handle)
		return first.fields(), err
	}, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data := make([]byte, len(state.Content))
	for offset := 0; offset < len(data); {
		var count uint32
		if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "ReadFile", func() (map[string]any, error) {
			var err error
			count, err = calls.read(handle, data[offset:])
			fields := nativeReadFields(data[offset:], count)
			fields["offset"] = offset
			return fields, err
		}, nil); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if count == 0 || uint64(count) > uint64(len(data)-offset) {
			return errors.New("native read made no progress or exceeded its buffer")
		}
		offset += int(count)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(data, state.Content) || digest(data) != state.ContentSHA256 {
		return errors.New("native content differs from the authority sentinel")
	}
	var eof [1]byte
	var count uint32
	if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "ReadFile(EOF)", func() (map[string]any, error) {
		var err error
		count, err = calls.read(handle, eof[:])
		fields := nativeReadFields(eof[:], count)
		fields["offset"], fields["expected_eof"] = len(data), true
		return fields, err
	}, func(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_HANDLE_EOF) && count == 0 }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count != 0 {
		return errors.New("native read returned bytes beyond the sentinel EOF")
	}
	var second nativeFileIdentity
	if err := observeNativeCall(ctx, record, "GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileIdInfo)", func() (map[string]any, error) {
		var err error
		second, err = calls.identity(handle)
		return second.fields(), err
	}, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := sameNativeIdentity(first, second); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fields := first.fields()
	fields["kind"], fields["status"] = "native-cold-check", "ok"
	fields["content_sha256"], fields["bytes"] = digest(data), len(data)
	fields["identity_scope"] = "one HANDLE, one object"
	return record(fields)
}

func nativeReadFields(data []byte, count uint32) map[string]any {
	fields := map[string]any{"requested": len(data), "bytes": count}
	if uint64(count) <= uint64(len(data)) {
		fields["sha256"] = digest(data[:count])
	}
	return fields
}
